cases.reason: First nonnil end error retained and subsequent opposite-end operations return it; repeated close returns nil.
General partially acknowledged write returns acknowledged count and reader close error; covers the specified two-of-six instance without depending on that literal size.
Zero-length write requires a read acknowledgment and succeeds, but the write return count/error pair is not explicitly stated; zero-length read pair is stated.

findings.reason: write loop and read copy/ack implement multi-read and zero-byte behavior; wrMu serializes writes.
After wrCh handoff reader sends rdCh without closure selection; otherwise writer selects done and returns accumulated n plus writeCloseError.
onceError retains first error, closeRead/closeWrite default nil error and return nil; peer error logic is conditioned on peer end open.
readCloseError/writeCloseError test their own stored error before yielding other-end error; both closed yields ErrClosedPipe.
Initial done select precedes wrMu, mutex serializes writes, later call may see done before locking.
PipeReader value copy before use copies channels and separate zero Once; closing one closes shared done, another close may panic; copying used locks remains explicitly unsupported/OPEN.
